subject: Greenleaf Health — Azure Marketplace private offer commercial discussion
messages:
From: Alyssa Grant <alyssa.grant@greenleafhealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@greenleafhealth.com, Mark Daniels <mdaniels@greenleafhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 15:22:00 -0400
Subject: Greenleaf marketplace private offer — commercial & SLA ask

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Greenleaf is keen to list Redwood via an Azure Private Offer. Procurement and Legal have a few asks up front so we can move to DocuSign quickly. High level:

- Term: 12 month committed entitlements (initial order 250k tokens/month).
- Pricing: Requesting a 15% discount off list for committed volume; need unit price breakdown for public vs. private offer.
- Billing & PO: Azure marketplace billing preferred (PO will reference Microsoft marketplace acquisition).
- Security/compliance: Please attach SOC 2 attestation and DPA; Legal needs confirmation on data handling and retention.
- SLA & credits: We require a 99.5% availability SLA for inference endpoints, with service credits capped at 30% of monthly invoice.
- Contract docs: We are attaching a draft SOW (Greenleaf_SOW_v1.docx) and will route contract redlines from Legal.

Can you confirm Redwood can accept the marketplace billing flow and provide a counter with the commercial terms you can sign to? Mark (Legal) would like an initial commercial counter by Wednesday 10/21 EOD Pacific.

Appreciate it — Alyssa
Alyssa Grant
Head of Procurement, Greenleaf Health
alyssa.grant@greenleafhealth.com
+1 415-555-0182

Attachment: Greenleaf_SOW_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Grant <alyssa.grant@greenleafhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greenleaf marketplace private offer — commercial & SLA ask

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks for the clear list. We’re excited to move forward with Greenleaf. Quick summary of what Redwood can commit to for the private offer (initial counter):

- Term & entitlements: 12 month minimum term with initial committed capacity of 250k tokens/month (can scale with mutual notice).
- Pricing: We can offer a 12% volume discount off list for the committed tier. Detailed per-token rates attached (Redwood_Counter_Terms_v1.pdf).
- Billing & PO: We accept Azure Marketplace purchase flow. Billing will be via Microsoft; invoices for Redwood consumption flow through the marketplace and remit to Redwood per the standard payout schedule.
- Security/compliance: SOC 2 Type II attestation and our DPA are attached; Redwood accepts data residency constraints stated in the SOW, with audit evidence to be provided via secure share.
- SLA: We can agree to a 99.5% availability SLO for the inference endpoints. Service credit structure: credit up to 25% of monthly invoice for qualifying outages.
- Commercial mechanics: We will provide a DocuSign envelope for the Private Offer and SOW once redlines are resolved.

Open items for your Legal/Procurement team to confirm:
- Whether Greenleaf requires IP escrow or modified indemnity language (we typically sign standard marketplace terms).
- Whether the PO needs Redwood legal entity/legal name variations on purchase order lines to match Azure.

I’ve attached our counter (Redwood_Counter_Terms_v1.pdf) with the redline focused on SLA credit cap and discount. If that looks OK, we’ll prepare DocuSign and routing for signature.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
+1 650-555-0133

Attachment: Redwood_Counter_Terms_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:10:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Greenleaf marketplace private offer — commercial & SLA ask

Marissa / Ben — forwarding Greenleaf thread and our proposed counter. Key asks from Procurement: 15% discount request, Azure marketplace billing, 99.5% SLA with credits. I am proposing we accept the deal with the following guardrails:

- Discount: Approve 12% off list for committed volume (we lose gross margin at 15%).
- SLA: Accept 99.5% with credit cap at 25% of monthly invoice. No IP escrow, standard indemnities; Legal to confirm if we need any tweaks.
- Revenue recognition / co-sell split: For marketplace private offers we typically follow the Marketplace revenue exhibit; recommend co-sell split of 80/20 (Redwood/Microsoft).
- Billing: Confirm Azure marketplace billing flow is fine; operations to coordinate entitlement provisioning.

I’ve attached a redline to our counter (counterterms_redline.pdf) — highlights: reduced credit cap, clarified force majeure, added clause to require Greenleaf to route PO with Redwood entity exact legal name.

Please respond with: (A) approval to proceed at 12% discount and 25% credit cap, (B) any Legal asks (Kimberly), and (C) confirm who will own DocuSign and seller onboarding checklist.

Thanks — Vivek

Subject: Final counter & DocuSign — Redwood x Greenleaf private offer

Alyssa / Mark —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Per our internal review (cc: Legal & Sales ops), Redwood can proceed under the following agreed commercial points. Please find a redlined summary attached and the DocuSign envelope link below.

Agreed commercial summary:
- Term: 12 months, initial committed 250k tokens/month.
- Pricing: 12% discount off list for committed volume (detailed rate card in attachment).
- Billing: Accept Azure Marketplace purchase flow; PO should reference the Microsoft acquisition ID and Redwood legal entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- SLA: 99.5% availability SLO. Service credit up to 25% of monthly invoice for qualifying events (as defined in the redline).
- Security: SOC 2 Type II attestation and DPA attached; Redwood will provide audit evidence on request via secure share.
- Redlines: We are not accepting IP escrow; indemnity language follows standard marketplace terms.

Next steps:
1) Please review and sign the DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.net/signature-request/ABCD-1234-GREENLEAF
2) Greenleaf to issue PO referencing marketplace acquisition ID once signature complete.
3) Onboarding call (ops + engineering) to schedule after signed SOW — propose Fri 10/23 or Mon 10/26.

If Legal needs a tracked-copy of the counterterms I can send the redline PDF. We’d appreciate signature by EOD 10/25 to lock the private offer provisioning this week.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
